'''Lourdes' homeworld''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world, there was at least one city on the planet, dotted with small stone buildings. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the world was conquered by the [[Yahk-Tosh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Gar-Oth]] and his droid army. Killing the [[Lourdes' father|King]], the warlord ruled the people of the world with fear. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Yoshi Raph-Elan]] crash-landed on the world and befriended [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Lourdes]], the duo were able to [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoshi Raph-Elan)|confront]] the warlord and assassinate him, liberating the world.
